worker_abilities.firefighter:
- Move a few steps in the the direction of a target coordinate location.
            - Cut down a single tree in your current cell.
            - Pick up a nearby civilian.
            - Drop off your current civilian.
            - Spray a wide cone of water in the direction of a target coordinate location.
            - Refill water. You must be on a water source.
            - Do nothing, remaining on standby and conserving energy.
worker_abilities.bulldozer:
- Move a few steps in the the direction of a target coordinate location.
            - Move a few steps in the the direction of a target coordinate location cutting all trees on the way there, creating a line of trees from your current location pointing towards the target location.
            - Do nothing, remaining on standby and conserving energy.
worker_abilities.drone:
- Move in the the direction of a target coordinate location, observing along the way.
            - Do nothing, remaining on standby and conserving energy.
worker_abilities.helicopter:
- Move in the the direction of a target coordinate location.
            - Pick up nearby Firefighter Agents, up to 5 total.
            - Drop off all carried Firefighter Agents.
            - Refill water storage. You must be above a water source.
            - Deploy 1 water directly below.
            - Do nothing, remaining on standby and conserving energy.
